# Bundled third-party dependency

`mediabunny-1.60.0.classic.js` is a browser-global wrapper around the
Mediabunny 1.60.0 minified ESM bundle from
[Mediabunny](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny), licensed under
[MPL-2.0](https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/). It is vendored so recording does
not depend on a third-party CDN request and works when this page is opened
directly from disk in Firefox.
